subject: Dedicated capacity demo — finding a slot with Orbital AI
messages:
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@orbitalai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — Orbital AI

Hi Irene / Redwood team,

We just spun up a few test runs against the self-serve endpoint and would like to evaluate Dedicated capacity for production. High-level:
- Workload: 50 RPS sustained, occasional bursts to 120 RPS
- Typical prompt length: ~220 tokens; responses ~180 tokens
- Quality: want same model variant, just dedicated pool + KV cache support
- SLO target: p95 latency under 120ms for 256-token context if possible

Can we schedule a demo to walk us through throughput/latency tradeoffs and what Reserved pools would look like for us? Our CTO (Sam Wu) and one SRE will join. Preferred week: Sep 14-18 (PST).

I attached a short CSV with sample latency traces and runner config.

Thanks,
Sam Wu
Platform Lead, Orbital AI
sam.wu@orbitalai.com
Attachment: orbital-latency-sample.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — Orbital AI

Hey Sam — great to see the sign-up and thanks for the data. I can run a tailored walkthrough that covers Dedicated pools, autoscaling, and p95 latency tuning.

Proposed 30/45 min slots (PST):
- Tue Sep 15, 09:30–10:00
- Wed Sep 16, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Sep 17, 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, here’s my quick Calendly: https://cal.redwood.com/b/ben/30min

Pre-demo ask: could you confirm the steady-state token-per-second estimate and whether you plan to use KV cache sharing across workers? That helps me bring the right benchmarks.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

Cc: platform@orbitalai.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — Orbital AI

Ben — thanks. Quick note: our CTO's schedule shifted and the only overlap is the morning of Sep 16 PST before 10:00. Is there any chance you can do Sep 16 at 09:00? If not, we can push to the following week.

Also, clarification on workload: steady-state is ~45 RPS (peak 120), average tokens/sec ~11k, and yes — we want KV cache shared across the pool for session affinity. I've attached the runner config and a short trace.

Hi Sam — Irene here (Solutions). Thanks for the details and for flagging the CTO's limited window. Ben, can you do Sep 16 at 09:00 PST? If not, I can host a short pre-brief with sample numbers and then hand off to Ben for the technical walkthrough.

To Orbital team: based on the numbers you shared, we will prepare:
- A dedicated pool sizing estimate (nodes + burst buffer)
- p95 latency projection for your token distribution with and without KV shared cache
- Example canary plan for a low-risk performance validation during your rollout

I've attached our Dedicated one-pager to outline what we'll cover. If your SRE can paste the runner config into a Doc (or share the drive link), that helps our engineering reps run a quick synthetic match to your traces ahead of the call.

Proposed: Sep 16, 09:00–09:45 PST — held as a soft hold; Ben, please confirm and send calendar invite.

Best,
Irene Choi
